pages.text: $(thing)Sand Plains$() are broad flats with scattered Deadwood. $(thing)Sand Hills$() roll upward and can have desert wolves. $(thing)Sand Dunes$() have higher banks and hollows. Plains and dunes can have camels.
pages.title: The Open Sands

pages.text: $(thing)Sparse Woods$() have widely spaced Deadwood. $(thing)Dense Woods$() have thicker trees and ground cover. Look for Anput’s Fingers in either woodland. Keep a trail through dense stands.
pages.title: Deadwood Country

pages.text: $(thing)Limestone Crags$() expose irregular rock and limestone spires. $(thing)Limestone Mountains$() are taller and steeper. Both can have wolves and emerald ore. Carry blocks for steep crossings.
pages.title: The Limestone Heights

pages.text: $(thing)Dried River$() is a dry low route instead of a dependable water source. $(thing)Oasis$() has pools, grass, papyrus, palms and acacia. Camels and quail are found here. Set up camp near usable water.
pages.title: Water and Old Rivers

pages.text: $(thing)Dead Oasis$() has withered palms and dry ground. It lacks the living oasis’s reliable water and has hostile spawns. Visit all ten biomes for A Journey.
pages.title: The Dead Oasis
